events.title: Working With Montabi is joining Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey Workmates,Working With Montabi is participating in Steam Next Fest! Let cute creatures and your typing avatar keep you company while you work, create, stream, or even play through your long list of Next Fest games. The demo is available on Windows and Mac! Your feedback really helps us to improve the game, so feel free to leave us a review on Steam and join our Discord to chat and discuss together!

events.title: Demo is now available on Mac!
events.summary: Hey Workmates,Working With Montabi Demo is now available on Mac! We’ve always wanted to bring Mac support from the get go and we’re happy to finally make it happen!Just in time before Steam Next Fest, you can now work with adorable creatures, type along with your avatar, and customize your workspace all at your own pace. events.title: Working With... Snarky Companion?
events.summary: Hey Workmate, Have you ever wanted to work with…A charmingly snarky companion who thrives in mischief and seems a little too happy in concerning situations? New crossover coming from the Institute to your room this October. Stay tuned for Working With Montabi demo release soon and join our Discord to stay updated!

events.title: First Playtest Signup is Open!
events.summary: Hey Workmates,We just announced Working With Montabi a few days ago and now we’re opening our first playtest! If you want to try working with Montabi in our new desktop companion, you can sign up for the playtest here.Also join our Discord to stay updated on everything Montabi, discuss with the community, and working together with Montabi!
